notes: Chat prompt asks for a 40 line list starting with LIST-<token> (Studio: 25 lines); each client is closed at its first visible reply text. Every case has its own conversation (Studio: own account, and own Product for the worker case). Cases run in parallel in one Stack.

Studio has no WebSocket send: the 'ws' client sends over HTTP (202) and observes over the Studio socket, which is then terminated. Studio worker = `interview` of a Product created through POST /v1/creator/products.
